 "rationale": "A simple mirror only reaches ~0.4 Mohm, so a cascode is required. A series resistor R from iin (cascode gates) to the bottom gates sets Vds1 to about 0.13 V. The bottom devices (L=2 um) and cascodes (L=1 um) both run in weak inversion with gm/Id of about 22, so Vdsat is about 0.08 V. Compliance is then about Vds1 + Vdsat4, roughly 0.21 V, and Rout ≈ gm4·ro4·ro2 > 10 Mohm. Both branches see identical Vds, so the current error comes only from mismatch. Total current is 40 uA."}

PARAMS = {
    "W1": (120.0, 30.0, 400.0),   # bottom mirror devices width [um]
    "L1": (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # bottom mirror L [um] (ro, matching)
    "W3": (60.0, 15.0, 240.0),    # cascode devices width [um]
    "L3": (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # cascode L [um]
    "vds_t": (0.13, 0.10, 0.18),  # target Vds of bottom devices (sets R)
    "R_scale": (1.0, 0.7, 1.4),   # trim ratio on computed bias resistor
}

def _vgs_for(lut, dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
    lo, hi = 0.2, 1.4
    for _ in range(50):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec["iin"]
    vout = spec["vout_nom"]
    W1, L1, W3, L3 = p["W1"], p["L1"], p["W3"], p["L3"]
    vds1 = p["vds_t"]

    # bottom device gate voltage at Vds = vds1
    vgs1 = _vgs_for(lut, "n", W1, L1, I, vds1)
    # cascode: source at vds1, drain (input side) at node a
    vgs3 = _vgs_for(lut, "n", W3, L3, I, 0.4, vsb=vds1)
    va = vgs3 + vds1
    vgs3 = _vgs_for(lut, "n", W3, L3, I, va - vds1, vsb=vds1)
    va = vgs3 + vds1
    # R drop = Va - Vg1
    R = max((va - vgs1) / I, 100.0) * p["R_scale"]

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # input branch: iin(=a, cascode gates) -R- b(bottom gates) ; M3 drain=b
    n.R("RB", "iin", "nb", R)
    n.M("M3", "nb", "iin", "nx", "vss", "nfet", W3, L3, m=4)
    n.M("M1", "nx", "nb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1, m=8)
    # output branch
    n.M("M4", "iout", "iin", "ny", "vss", "nfet", W3, L3, m=4)
    n.M("M2", "ny", "nb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1, m=8)

    # predictions
    vds1_act = va - I * R - (I * R - I * R)  # Vg1 = va - I*R
    vg1 = va - I * R
    op2 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vg1, vds1)
    op4 = lut.op("n", W3, L3, vgs3, vout - vds1, vsb=vds1)
    ro2 = 1.0 / max(op2["gds"], 1e-12)
    ro4 = 1.0 / max(op4["gds"], 1e-12)
    gm4 = op4["gm"]
    rout = ro4 + ro2 + gm4 * ro4 * ro2
    iout = op2["Id"]
    # input side Vds of M1 equals vds1 by construction; residual error from Rout
    dv = vout - (vg1 + I * R)
    err = abs(iout * (1 + dv / rout / max(iout, 1e-12)) - spec["iout_target"]) / spec["iout_target"] * 100
    vcomp = vds1 + max(op4.get("vdsat", 0.08), 0.06)
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": vcomp,
               "power": 2 * I * 1.8}
